subject: paddlefish
title: This Fish Has a Sword on Its Face and Never Stabs Anything

scenes.text: This fish has a sword on its face. It has never stabbed anything.
The American paddlefish grows over eight feet long. On a young one, that snout is nearly half its body.
It isn't a weapon. It isn't a shovel either. Scientists found it is covered in electric sensors.
Plankton give off faint electric signals. In muddy water, a young paddlefish can sense a single one.
So it just swims with its mouth wide open, and long gill rakers sieve out whatever the snout found.
That sword is really an antenna. The fish hunts with electricity.

description:
This fish has a sword on its face, and it has never stabbed anything.
The American paddlefish snout is covered in electric sensors that pick up faint signals from plankton, even in muddy water.
Would you have guessed that was an antenna?
first_comment: Which animal would you give a built-in antenna to? Tell us the weirdest sensor you know.
